roadmap.title: Opening: Chapters 1-3
roadmap.description: Play the opening chapters. Spam meow and jump on the way for the two counter unlocks, take the scripted fall and the B-12 recharge, then use the first Zurk chase for the clean run and the nine deaths.

roadmap.title: The Slums (Chapter 4)
roadmap.description: Talk to the Guard, then do the Slums tasks: basketball, paper bag, TV channels, and all eight sheets of music for Morusque.

roadmap.title: Sewers (Chapter 8)
roadmap.description: Finish the Sewers chapter without killing a Zurk.

roadmap.title: Midtown to the finale (Chapters 10-12)
roadmap.description: Enter Midtown, get through the factory and apartment complex unseen, scratch the record in the nightclub, then finish the story.

roadmap.title: Collectible cleanup
roadmap.description: Check the inventory and use Chapter Select for anything missed: memories, badges, nuzzles, and one scratch per chapter. Do the one-hour sleep last.

roadmap.title: Speedrun
roadmap.description: Start a new game in an empty save slot and finish the story in under 2 hours.

achievements.summary: Meow 100 times.

steps.text: Press the meow button until the achievement unlocks (Left Alt on keyboard, B on Xbox, O on PlayStation). It works anywhere, even while you walk through the pipes at the start.

achievements.summary: Jump 500 times.

steps.text: Keep jumping anywhere in the game until you reach 500 jumps.
To speed it up, go to the row of four pipes in Chapter 1 and jump back and forth there for about 100 jumps.

achievements.description: Sleep for more than one hour.
achievements.summary: Sleep for more than one hour of real time.

steps.text: Find a spot where the cat can sleep, such as the cat bed beside @npc{Morusque} in Chapter 4, and press interact (Q on keyboard) to lie down.
Leave the game alone for more than one hour without pressing anything. Keep the game unpaused, and make sure your controller or computer does not switch off or go to sleep.

achievements.summary: Dunk the basketball by pushing it into the trash can in the Slums.

guide.context: The ball resets each time the game saves, so giving @npc{Morusque} a sheet of music also gives you a new try.

steps.text: In @loc{The Slums} (Chapter 4), find the basketball at the top of the ramp that leads down to a trash can.
Push the ball down the ramp into the trash can. If it misses, reload the last checkpoint and try again.

achievements.description: Get through the first Zurk chase without being caught.
achievements.summary: Finish the first Zurk chase in Chapter 2 without being touched by any Zurk.

guide.context: The chase lasts about one minute. If a Zurk grabs you and a shake-off prompt appears, reload the last checkpoint and start again.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, after you fall into the city, run from the @enemy{Zurks} when the chase begins.
Run in a zigzag and stay close to the walls. Do not let any Zurk touch you.
The achievement unlocks when you go through the window that ends the chase.

achievements.description: Pass the Sentinel drones in Midtown without being detected.
achievements.summary: Get from the factory in Midtown to the nightclub without any Sentinel drone spotting you.

guide.context: In Chapter 10, you must stay unseen from the moment you are carried into the factory until you reach the nightclub. A drone's search cone stays blue until it spots you. If it turns yellow or red, reload the last checkpoint right away. Checkpoints are far apart, and meowing near drones can alert them.

steps.text: Drone 1 (factory): run past its right side while it looks left.
Drones 2 and 3: in the room after that, watch the left drone until it drifts toward the right one. Then hop over the barrels floating in the water behind both.
Drone 4: climb the box to its left to reach a switch behind it and pull it. Hop the railing, crouch behind the middle crates until it looks away, then dash to the door that has opened on the left.
Drones 5 and 6: in the corridor with moving containers, stay behind the containers so the drones cannot see you.
Drones 7 and 8: cross the water on the barrels, slip behind the left drone, then keep a moving container between you and drone 8 as you pass.
At the end of the corridor, jump into the barrel in front of the red lasers and roll it through the laser grid.
Wake the right-hand robot and walk it over to the fence on the left. Climb the fence, pull the switch that opens the fence door, and wake the second robot behind it.
Put one robot on the left pad and the other on the right pad. Then roll the barrel in a straight line onto the middle pad and ride the bucket zipline outside to leave the factory.
Drones 9 and 10 (apartment lobby): these two stay put and only swing their lights around. Sneak from cover to cover while the lights point away, then climb the stairs in front of you.

Drones 11 to 13: on this floor, enter the left corridor, then the middle one (skip the far-right corridor). While the patrolling drone looks away, hop the railing and land on the air-conditioning units behind it. When it flies the other way, climb back up to get behind it. Then use the stairs on the left.
Drones 14 and 15: hop the railing and cross the middle beam to reach @npc{Clementine}'s apartment. Once the patrolling drone moves to the right, leap through her window.

After you finish in the apartment, jump out of the window while the patrolling drone faces away and land on the middle beam. Drop down the ledges and air-conditioning units to the lobby when the lobby drone looks away, then run outside toward the nightclub.

achievements.summary: Die 9 times.

guide.context: Only Zurk bites and Sentinel electrocution can kill the cat.

steps.text: In the Chapter 2 Zurk chase, let the @enemy{Zurks} bite you until the cat dies, then repeat from the checkpoint until you have died 9 times in total.

achievements.description: Scratch a vinyl record in the nightclub.
achievements.summary: Scratch the vinyl record on the DJ turntable in the nightclub.

steps.text: In the Chapter 10 nightclub, pick up the record from the table.
Put the record on the turntable on the main stage, in front of the DJ robot.
Interact with the turntable and scratch the record.

achievements.description: Get through the Sewers without killing any Zurk.
achievements.summary: Finish the Sewers chapter without killing any Zurk.

guide.context: Only the Sewers chapter counts. Zurks that die by falling into water or other causes do not count as your kills, and checkpoints are frequent.

steps.text: In Chapter 8, never use the purple UV flashlight on a Zurk, and do not touch Zurk pods.
Run past the Zurks. If one bites you, shake it off (Left Alt on keyboard, B on Xbox, O on PlayStation). In a chase, keep zigzagging.
At the start, go round to the right of the pull lever, sprint to pull it down, and leave forward. Circle the platform with the Zurks about three times, then jump on the boat.
At the door that needs two terminals unlocked together, unlock the left terminal first. Then sprint to the right, take the side pipe, and unlock the right terminal.
If you kill a Zurk by accident, reload the last checkpoint.

achievements.description: Complete the game in less than 2 hours.
achievements.summary: Finish the whole story in less than 2 hours.

guide.context: A smooth run takes about 1 hour 30 minutes. Loading black screens do not count. Dialogue, cutscenes (which you cannot skip), deaths, and checkpoint restarts do count.

steps.text: Pick an empty save slot and begin fresh, ideally once you have finished every other achievement and know the route.
Tap the dialogue buttons rapidly to blast through conversations (Xbox: X and B. PlayStation: O and Square).
Avoid deaths and checkpoint restarts, because they add to your time.

Chapter 11 has a section where two drones must be shut in a storage room. Use code 3748 for the drone room. The room with the secret door uses code 2511. This section is easy to die in, so practice it on an earlier run.
To stop the timer, pause the game or quit to the main menu. You can see a save slot's time by hovering over it on the title screen.

achievements.summary: Fall from the pipes into the underground city.

steps.text: Early in the story, jump from one pipe to the other across the open gap. You miss and fall into the underground city; this always happens.

achievements.summary: Fully charge B-12 in the flat to meet him.

steps.text: In Chapter 3 (the flat), solve the electricity puzzle to fully charge B-12.

achievements.summary: Talk to the Guard robot in the Slums so B-12 translates for you.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, walk into @loc{The Slums} and talk to @npc{the Guard}, the first robot you meet.

achievements.summary: Walk out of the subway station into Midtown.

steps.text: In Chapter 10, leave the subway station and walk onto the Midtown street.

achievements.summary: Get stunned by the Sentinels and locked in a jail cell.

steps.text: Continue the Chapter 10 story until the Sentinels stun you and lock you in a cell.

achievements.summary: Open the dome at the end of the game.

steps.text: Finish the story in Chapter 12 by opening the dome.

achievements.description: Bring all the music sheets to Morusque.
achievements.summary: Give all 8 sheets of music to Morusque in the Slums.

guide.context: Give each sheet to @npc{Morusque}, the guitar robot. He pins each one on his wall, four to a row, so you can see how many are left. If you hand over several at once, wait for the song to end before giving the next. Do this on your first visit to Chapter 4, because a replay means collecting all 8 again. The last sheet also gives you the Music Badge.

collectibles.name: Momo's dark room

collectibles.method: Enter the dark room and pick up the sheet.

collectibles.name: Clementine's balcony
collectibles.location: @loc{The Slums}, a balcony beside the entrance to @npc{Clementine}'s home
collectibles.method: Climb onto the balcony and pick up the sheet.

collectibles.name: Apartment near Granny
collectibles.method: Scratch the door to be let in by a robot. The sheet is pinned to the ground-floor wall.

collectibles.name: Market trade
collectibles.method: Trade one energy drink for the sheet. Get the drink from one of the four vending machines first.

collectibles.name: Bar, second floor
collectibles.method: Go up to the second floor and take the sheet from the table.

collectibles.name: Clementine's bookshelf
collectibles.method: Take the sheet from the bookshelf.

collectibles.name: Doc's piano
collectibles.method: Take the sheet from the piano.

collectibles.name: Safe by Morusque
collectibles.method: Take down the picture hanging in the bar to find the code, then enter 1283 in the safe.

achievements.summary: Put on a paper bag.

guide.context: The bag reverses your controls for a while, then comes off on its own.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, go to @npc{Morusque} and find the paper bag beside him, behind the red cat sign. Press interact (Q on keyboard) to put it on.

achievements.description: Try to play mahjong with the robots.
achievements.summary: Try to play mahjong with the two robots in Antvillage by jumping onto their table.

steps.text: In Chapter 9, climb the ladder on the left to find two robots playing mahjong. Hop onto their table to wreck the game.

guide.context: You only need 5 of these 10 robots. A nuzzle shows up as a second interact option near a robot. A nuzzle repeated on a Chapter Select replay still counts.

achievements.summary: Find all 27 of B-12's memories.

guide.context: Some memories unlock by themselves during the story, and others are hidden. Your inventory (unlocked in Chapter 3) lists the ones you have. A memory only saves when the game reaches an autosave. When you finish all 27, B-12 gives you a colorful backpack.

collectibles.name: Seaside postcards
collectibles.method: Walk close to the seaside murals and postcards. It unlocks by itself.

collectibles.name: White vending machine
collectibles.location: Side street near the start of the chapter
collectibles.method: Take the memory beside the white vending machine. Take the energy drink from the machine too.

collectibles.name: Bar billiard table
collectibles.location: Upstairs in the bar across from @npc{the Guard}
collectibles.method: Take the memory from the table beside the billiard table.

collectibles.name: Damaged robot on the roof
collectibles.method: Take the memory from the damaged robot.

collectibles.name: Back Home 2 poster
collectibles.method: Check the Back Home 2 game poster.

collectibles.name: Potted plant
collectibles.method: Scratch the door and a robot lets you in. Upstairs, check the potted plant.

collectibles.name: Waving robot mural
collectibles.method: Climb to the second floor and check the mural of a waving robot.

collectibles.name: Market trade
collectibles.method: Trade 3 energy drinks for the memory. Vending machines: white, at the side street near the start; red, on the roof near @npc{Momo}'s home below the TV; blue, opposite @npc{Morusque}; yellow, up the wooden ladder at the end of the street near @npc{Granny}.

collectibles.name: Neon sign
collectibles.method: Check the neon sign.

collectibles.name: Construction site sign
collectibles.location: Far end of the construction site's upper level
collectibles.method: Go through the area covered in Zurk eggs and take the memory from the sign in the middle.

collectibles.name: Receiver
collectibles.method: Install the receiver. The memory unlocks by itself.

collectibles.name: First intersection
collectibles.location: After you go through the door into the street
collectibles.method: Take the memory down the left branch at the first intersection.

collectibles.name: Fork after the chase
collectibles.method: Keep going straight at the fork and take the memory.

collectibles.name: Doc's dummy
collectibles.method: Check the dummy.

collectibles.name: Egg corridor pipe
collectibles.location: The corridor full of Zurk eggs, soon after @npc{Momo} opens the door
collectibles.method: Turn left, dash through the eggs on the ground, and drop into the left pipe. Follow it to the end to find the memory.

collectibles.name: Water pipe after the chase
collectibles.location: After the first chase where you see eyes on the wall
collectibles.method: At the end of the chase, you land on a water pipe. Walk left, the opposite way from the story, to find the memory.

collectibles.name: Entering Antvillage
collectibles.method: It unlocks by itself as you enter.

collectibles.name: Graffiti
collectibles.location: Room next to the purple plant
collectibles.method: Check the graffiti on the wall.

collectibles.name: Subway station
collectibles.method: It unlocks by itself as you enter.

collectibles.name: Beside Ledoc
collectibles.location: Turn right after you leave the subway station
collectibles.method: Take the memory next to @npc{Ledoc}.

collectibles.name: Yellow light climb
collectibles.location: At the next fork, turn right
collectibles.method: Climb up toward the yellow light to find the memory.

collectibles.name: Corner store
collectibles.location: A corner of the central square
collectibles.method: Climb up along the counter and take the memory from the mezzanine.

collectibles.name: Store opposite the corner store
collectibles.method: Enter through the window and take the memory from the upper mezzanine.

collectibles.name: Security room
collectibles.method: Take the battery in the factory first. Then the security room door opens and the memory is inside.

collectibles.name: Nightclub basement
collectibles.method: Take the elevator behind the bar to the basement and find the memory.

collectibles.name: Damaged robot
collectibles.location: After the first yard where you lock the Sentinels away
collectibles.method: Take the memory from the damaged robot.

collectibles.name: Control room
collectibles.method: It unlocks by itself as you enter.

achievements.description: Browse through all of the TV channels.
achievements.summary: Browse all 8 channels on the rooftop TV in the Slums.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, climb to the rooftops near @npc{Momo}'s home. Jump on the couch and use the remote (interact) to switch channels until you have seen all 8.

achievements.summary: Collect all 6 badges for the cat's backpack.

guide.context: The badges show up as stickers on the side of the cat's backpack. Each has its own picture, so you can see which one is missing.

collectibles.name: Music Badge
collectibles.method: Give him all 8 sheets of music.

collectibles.name: Outsider Badge
collectibles.method: It is given to you by @npc{Seamus} in dialogue when he opens the door. You do not need to do anything.

collectibles.name: Plant Badge
collectibles.method: Bring him a purple, a red, and a yellow plant. Purple: seen as soon as you enter; climb the branches. Red: use the lift behind the mahjong table to reach the bottom of the village, then climb the branches. Yellow: on @npc{Zbaltazar}'s floor, climb the wall behind the restaurant. For Malo, climb the ladder from the restaurant, then the wall pipe up one more floor.

collectibles.name: Cat Badge
collectibles.method: Jump through the window of the second shop on the right. Climb the shelves at the back right to the safe on top. Enter code 8542 and take the badge.

collectibles.name: Police Badge
collectibles.location: @loc{Midtown} (Chapter 10), the alley between two yellow-lit shops
collectibles.method: From the large hologram robot across from the restaurant, go down the steps behind it and turn into the first alley on your right. Climb the AC units and roofs up the alley to the barred window and enter the cell. Take the badge from the dead robot.

collectibles.name: Neco Badge
collectibles.method: A worker robot in the third room asks you to find his keys. The key is in the corner of an island in the next room, among the barrels in the water. Bring the key back to him to get the badge.

achievements.summary: Scratch something in each of the 12 chapters.

guide.context: You need one scratch per chapter, on any spot you can scratch. Interact (Q on keyboard) with a tree, carpet, or similar object. Scratch with the mouse buttons or triggers for about 5 seconds, then end the scratch yourself, because it does not stop on its own. Walk on to the next autosave so it counts.
